name: link-message-throughput
title: Link-message throughput
summary: Sustained delivery of small messages over one established link.
description: One link saturated with windowed small single-packet sends for a fixed wall-time - the same data shape as single-packet-throughput carried by the other mechanism: a session key amortizes the per-message crypto that singles pay per packet, while ProveAll still proves every delivery. The contrast between the two firehoses is the measurement.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts. A locally culled receipt is explicit backpressure rather than a wire send or timeout; it contracts the active window instead of triggering another immediate send.
